content.text:
`writing_plan.yaml` 已保存。结构覆盖：

- **7 sections outline**，每个标注 `write_now` / `partial` / `wait` 状态
- **6 figures** (VOTA schematic, decomposition bar, cross-model comparison, hierarchy bar, reliability diagram, seed robustness)
- **4 tables** (main results, cross-model, calibration, seed robustness)
- **文献策略**：3 core competitors (DCSH, TracePile, TRACED) + calibration ref + methodological refs，预计 25-35 篇
- **6-phase 写作时间线**：Phase 1-2 (5/15-17) Method+RW+Results 并行 → Phase 3 (5/17-18) Intro+Discussion → Phase 4 (5/18-19) Conclusion+Abstract → Phase 5 (5/19-22) Review 迭代 → Phase 6 (5/23-24) 提交
- **4 pending items**：DeepSeek full_trace v3 (non-blocking), 额外 seed, per-bin calibration data, plan_005 DebugBench — 全部有 fallback 方案

写作优先级：先 Method + Related Work（不依赖 pending），再 Results（数据 95% 就绪），最后 Intro/Conclusion（需要全文定稿后写）。
